name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) Rollout & Structural Realignment
macro_context: Dismantling of inter-state trade barriers and transition from cascading state taxes to a unified indirect tax regime.
transmission_mechanism: Supply chain de-stocking and warehouse consolidation caused temporary Q1-Q2 FY18 inventory drawdowns, followed by permanent market-share migration from unorganized players to organized sector leaders.
documented_outcome: Near-term earnings hit for 2 quarters; long-term margin expansion and formalization dividend for organized tier-1 players.
key_lessons: Regulatory formalization shocks penalize working capital initially, but widen the moat of organized market leaders.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Modern supply chains are already computerized; current logistics shocks are more localized or freight-cost driven rather than systemic tax transition.

name: Demonetisation Currency Shock
macro_context: Sudden invalidation of 86% of currency in circulation (₹500 and ₹1,000 banknotes) to curb black money and drive digitization.
transmission_mechanism: Severe liquidity crunch in cash-driven consumption sectors; real estate transaction volumes collapsed, while digital payment processing surged exponentially.
documented_outcome: Cash-dependent discretionary spending paused for 3-6 months; massive accelerated institutionalization of FinTech, UPI, and formal banking deposits.
key_lessons: Cash velocity drops cause sharp non-linear demand shocks, but structural digitization catalysts produce durable multi-year winners.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Today's retail economy is predominantly digital via UPI; cash-handling sensitivity has declined by >60% across urban/semi-urban commerce.

name: IL&FS Default & Wholesale NBFC Liquidity Squeeze
macro_context: AAA-rated infrastructure lender defaulted on commercial paper, freezing the domestic wholesale debt and debt mutual fund market.
transmission_mechanism: Asset-Liability Mismatch (ALM) exposure triggered commercial paper rollover failure; cost of borrowing spiked for wholesale NBFCs, triggering flight to quality towards retail deposit-heavy private banks.
documented_outcome: Wholesale and real-estate focused NBFCs experienced multi-year valuation de-rating; well-capitalized private banks gained outsized loan market share.
key_lessons: Wholesale debt market freezes punish liability-fragile NBFCs; balance sheet resilience and granular low-cost retail deposits (CASA) outperform asset yields.
counter_analogy_guidelines: RBI Scale-Based Regulations (SBR) have since strictly mandated ALM buffers and liquidity coverage ratios (LCR) for upper-layer NBFCs.

name: COVID-19 Pandemic Lockdown & Liquidity Stimulus
macro_context: Global nationwide physical lockdowns followed by unprecedented coordinated central bank monetary easing and fiscal support.
transmission_mechanism: Immediate collapse in physical contact businesses; unprecedented global demand explosion for enterprise cloud transformation and active pharmaceutical ingredients (API).
documented_outcome: Panic trough in March 2020 followed by one of the sharpest fundamental re-ratings in Indian IT, Pharma, and digital platform businesses, alongside rapid balance sheet deleveraging.
key_lessons: Exogenous liquidity shocks trigger blind emotional panic-selling; companies with zero net debt and operational agility emerge with higher return on equity (ROE).
counter_analogy_guidelines: Do not treat pandemic-era super-normal earnings in IT/Pharma as permanent baselines; normalization cycles eventually occur.

name: Corporate Tax Rate Reduction (30% to 22%)
macro_context: Union Government slashed effective corporate tax rate from ~35% to 25.17% (and 15% for new manufacturing entities) to stimulate private capital expenditure.
transmission_mechanism: Instantaneous 8-10% uplift in corporate net profits for cash-generating domestic businesses; accelerated balance sheet debt paydown and increased dividend payouts.
documented_outcome: Immediate stock rally across high-tax paying domestic sectors; multi-year debt deleveraging across Indian corporate balance sheets.
key_lessons: Structural tax reductions create an enduring step-function increase in free cash flow, unlike temporary subsidies.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Tax cut benefits were captured by balance-sheet repair first, with private Capex cycles only visibly picking up 3 years later post-COVID.

name: RBI Post-Pandemic Rate Hike Cycle (4.00% to 6.50%)
macro_context: Global inflationary surge following supply bottlenecks and energy crises prompted RBI to hike policy repo rate by 250 bps.
transmission_mechanism: External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR) linked loans repriced faster than term deposits, causing Net Interest Margins (NIMs) to peak initially before deposit cost repricing caught up.
documented_outcome: Banks enjoyed record profitability in FY23; housing loan demand remained surprisingly resilient due to pent-up consumer affluence.
key_lessons: Rate hike cycles benefit retail asset-heavy banks in the first 2-3 quarters; margin compression hits later when deposit competition intensifies.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Present day credit-deposit (CD) ratios are at historical highs (~78-80%), making deposit repricing faster than in 2022.

name: National Calamity Contingent Duty (NCCD) & Cigarette Excise Hikes
macro_context: Budget announcements imposing 13-16% tax escalations on specified tobacco product lines.
transmission_mechanism: Near-term stock selloff due to fears of margin erosion; followed by systematic, staggered 2-3% pack price hikes by dominant market players passing 100% of tax to retail consumers.
documented_outcome: Short-term volume flatlined for 1 quarter; pricing power restored EBITDA margins within 6-9 months.
key_lessons: Monopoly/Oligopoly franchises with inelastic consumer demand absorb regulatory tax hikes without enduring economic damage.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Modern diversified FMCG/hotel conglomerates have lower revenue dependency on single tobacco lines compared to historical decades.

name: Export Duty Imposition on Steel & Iron Ore
macro_context: 15% export duty placed on steel products by Ministry of Finance to curb domestic inflation.
transmission_mechanism: Export volumes collapsed overnight; domestic market faced acute inventory glut and price realization fell >20% within 4 months.
documented_outcome: Severe quarterly margin erosion for primary steel producers (Tata Steel, JSW); duty was withdrawn 6 months later after inflation cooled.
key_lessons: Ad-hoc export duties directly penalize cyclical commodity exporters; domestic manufacturing downstream users gain at their expense.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Always treat export restrictions as transient political interventions rather than permanent structural impairments.

name: Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) Industrial Push
macro_context: Government announced ₹1.97 Lakh Crore incentive scheme across 14 champion sectors to build domestic scale.
transmission_mechanism: Requires massive upfront Capex and local employment thresholds before incentive disbursements trigger; drives contract manufacturing volume.
documented_outcome: Massive revenue growth for Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) players (Dixon, Amber); margins remained modest but asset turnover multiplied.
key_lessons: PLI schemes favor high-turnover assemblers and scale operators; profitability must be evaluated through ROIC rather than gross margin alone.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Disbursement delays are common; monitor actual government credit releases versus announced MoUs.

name: SEBI T+1 / Same-Day Rolling Settlement Migration
macro_context: Transition from T+2 to phased T+1 settlement cycle across all Indian equities, leading global markets.
transmission_mechanism: Freed up retail client collateral faster, lowered broker margin buffer requirements, and improved liquidity velocity.
documented_outcome: Seamless operational transition; amplified retail participation and turnover volumes on NSE and BSE.
key_lessons: Market plumbing efficiency reduces systemic counterparty risk and drives institutional capital allocation to Indian equities.
counter_analogy_guidelines: T+0 and instant settlement bring additional intraday banking API dependencies.

name: Real Estate Regulation and Development Act (RERA) Enforcement
macro_context: Mandatory project registration, escrow accounts for 70% of buyer collections, and penalties for completion delays.
transmission_mechanism: Unregulated, highly leveraged local developers unable to launch projects; customer trust consolidated into branded, corporatized tier-1 developers.
documented_outcome: Multi-year industry consolidation; listed branded developers gained unprecedented market share and pricing power.
key_lessons: Severe consumer-protection regulations extinguish fly-by-night operators and award monopoly rents to compliant corporate incumbents.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Top developers are now highly disciplined on cash flow; the era of wild speculative land-banking has ended.

name: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) Enactment
macro_context: Time-bound resolution process for non-performing corporate loans ending the era of 'evergreening'.
transmission_mechanism: Promoters risked losing control of their companies upon default; led to record provisioning and resolution of legacy bad loans in the steel and power sectors.
documented_outcome: Public sector bank balance sheets thoroughly cleansed by 2021; gross NPAs dropped from 11.2% in 2018 to below 3% by 2023.
key_lessons: Clean credit cycles unlock multi-year banking sector outperformance once legacy provisioning peaks.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Resolution timelines have slowed down in NCLT; current stress is in small unsecured retail rather than big-ticket corporate debt.

name: Geopolitical Crude Oil Surge ($130/bbl)
macro_context: Russian invasion of Ukraine triggered global energy panic, spiking Brent crude to $130/bbl and inflating India's import bill.
transmission_mechanism: Indian OMCs (IOC, BPCL, HPCL) froze retail petrol/diesel prices to shield consumers, absorbing immense marketing losses; raw material costs for paint/chemical companies rose sharply.
documented_outcome: Severe 2-quarter loss for downstream OMCs, followed by windfall recovery as discount Russian Ural crude was imported and refined.
key_lessons: Regulated retail pricing in PSU energy creates asymmetric downside during crude spikes; downstream chemical users face gross margin compression.
counter_analogy_guidelines: India has diversified crude sourcing with permanent currency settlement arrangements in rupees and dirhams.

name: Supreme Court Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR) Ruling
macro_context: Supreme Court upheld DoT's definition of AGR, requiring telcos to pay historical statutory dues with interest and penalties.
transmission_mechanism: Tens of thousands of crores in unanticipated liabilities hit telecom operators; accelerated market transition from 6+ players into an effective duopoly.
documented_outcome: Vodafone Idea entered near-bankruptcy distress; Bharti Airtel and Jio instituted sustained tariff hikes and expanded average revenue per user (ARPU).
key_lessons: Judicial verdicts on retrospective regulatory dues can permanently alter industry structure and eliminate marginal players.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Government has demonstrated willingness to convert dues into equity to prevent total duopoly collapse.

name: Mega Consolidation of Public Sector Banks (10 into 4)
macro_context: Government merged 10 public sector banks into 4 anchor institutions (e.g. PNB, Canara Bank, Union Bank, Indian Bank).
transmission_mechanism: IT system integration, branch rationalization, and cultural harmonisation occupied management attention for 18 months, slowing credit growth during integration.
documented_outcome: Post-integration, PSBs emerged with stronger capital adequacy, reduced administrative overhead, and competitive digital apps.
key_lessons: Merger integrations cause near-term operational friction, but yield substantial operational leverage once technology stacks converge.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Current banking mergers (like HDFC Ltd into HDFC Bank) are private sector and regulatory capital driven rather than government fiat.

name: Windfall Profit Tax on Domestic Crude & Fuel Exports
macro_context: Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) imposed on domestic crude oil producers and refined fuel exporters harvesting super-normal refinery margins.
transmission_mechanism: Capped the realization of upstream crude producers at around $75/bbl regardless of global crude price, preventing upside earnings explosion.
documented_outcome: Government instituted fortnightly reviews calibrated to international prices, treating the tax as a dynamic stabilizer.
key_lessons: Extremely high commodity windfalls are frequently clawed back by sovereign taxation; model earnings with normalized spreads.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Tax is dynamically calibrated every 14 days and drops to zero when global crack spreads normalize.

name: Defense Positive Indigenisation Lists & Domestic Capex Earmarking
macro_context: Banning import of over 400 defense items and earmarking >75% of defense capital procurement budget for domestic vendors.
transmission_mechanism: Order books for domestic defense firms (HAL, BEL, Mazagon Dock) grew to 3-5x annual revenues with sovereign payment security.
documented_outcome: Unprecedented multi-year valuation re-rating for Indian defense contractors and technology suppliers.
key_lessons: Policy-mandated import bans paired with guaranteed sovereign budget allocation produce long-duration revenue runways.
counter_analogy_guidelines: High valuations require meticulous monitoring of execution speed and milestone delivery rather than mere order book size.

name: India Semiconductor Mission ($10B Fiscal Outlay)
macro_context: 50% project cost capital subsidy by Central Government paired with state incentives to build domestic chip fabrication and ATMP units.
transmission_mechanism: Attracted global joint ventures (Tata-PSMC, Micron ATMP in Gujarat); creates long-tail demand for industrial engineering, specialized gases, and clean power.
documented_outcome: Capex commitments formalized; commercial production timelines span 3-5 years before revenue realization.
key_lessons: High-tech foundational infrastructure requires patient capital; benefit accrues first to engineering and utility suppliers before chipmakers.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Commercial revenue is backloaded; focus on construction and equipment procurement stages.

name: RBI Risk Weight Escalation on Unsecured Consumer Credit
macro_context: RBI raised risk weights on consumer credit exposure (personal loans, credit cards) by 25 percentage points (100% to 125%).
transmission_mechanism: Increased capital consumption per loan; raised cost of bank funding for NBFCs and forced underwriting tightening in small-ticket personal loans.
documented_outcome: Unsecured credit growth slowed from >30% to sub-15%; FinTech loan disbursals contracted while asset quality was proactively protected.
key_lessons: RBI regulatory pre-emptive macro-prudential tightening stops asset bubbles before they contaminate systemic balance sheets.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Direct regulatory risk-weighting affects capital adequacy ratios directly, unlike interest rate changes which work through demand.

name: Reintroduction of Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) Tax on Equities
macro_context: 10% tax reintroduced on equity capital gains exceeding ₹1 Lakh after 14 years of 0% LTCG regime.
transmission_mechanism: Near-term market knee-jerk correction and widespread retail outrage; grandfathering clause protected gains up to January 31, 2018.
documented_outcome: Market absorbed the tax within 2 months; systematic investment plan (SIP) monthly inflows continued unbroken growth trajectory.
key_lessons: Tax changes on equity gains cause transient sentiment dips, but do not derail structural financialisation of household savings.
counter_analogy_guidelines: Indian retail domestic liquidity via monthly SIPs has grown from ₹7,000 Cr/month in 2018 to >₹23,000 Cr/month today, providing an immense liquidity cushion.
